_comment: Named model configurations for amp. Selected with --model-config NAME:VARIANT,
A variant is a set of DEFAULTS, never an override. Any flag you pass on the command line
still wins: --model-config occamy:v2 -ctv f16 -c 131072 gives you v2's prompt-cache and
checkpoint settings with your own KV dtype and context. That is the whole point of putting
this in a file rather than in code - you can retune a variant without rebuilding, and you
Because n_parallel defaults to 2, the context you actually get PER CONVERSATION is
n_ctx / n_parallel. v2 is sized so that 400000 / 2 = 200000 per conversation.
Keys, all optional, all of which fall back to the built-in default when absent:
n_ctx              total context across all slots
cache_ram_mib      llama.cpp RAM prompt cache, MiB. 0 disables it.
n_ubatch           physical batch size for prompt processing

occamy.description: Occamy-1.0 APEX-I MiniPlus V2.1 (qwen35moe hybrid: 30 recurrent + 10 attention layers of 40, 256 experts, 8 active)

v1.label: v1 q8_0/q4_0, 200k total (the pre-2026-09-27 default)
v1._measured: sustained prefill ~85-100 t/s, decode ~27.7 t/s, median KL 1.809e-06 from f16. Kept because it is the only variant measured on more than one prompt at the old setting, and because it needs the least VRAM.

v2.label: v2 q8_0/q8_0, 200k per conversation (current default)
v2._measured: sustained prefill ~245 t/s (3x v1, the prompt cache was evicting the model page cache), decode ~28.3 t/s, median KL 2.065e-07 from f16 which is 8.8x closer to f16 than v1. n_ctx_checkpoints is 1 rather than 2 because a checkpoint stores the full memory state and at 400k two of them is several GiB of anonymous RAM on a 14.3 GiB box.

v3.label: v3 f16/f16, 131k total - highest precision that FITS on 6 GB
v3._measured: f16/f16 does NOT fit at 200k on this box at all: it fails with 'failed to allocate compute pp buffers' even at 0 GPU expert layers, because the KV cache alone would need about 3.9 GiB of the 5.89 GiB budget. 131072 is the largest context measured to start, and it does, with 3 GPU expert layers. Per conversation that is 65536 at the default 2 slots; pass --parallel 1 for 131072 per conversation, at the cost of the mid-conversation stall that single-slot serving has (see AGENT.md). This is the closest available to the reference, not a claim of zero divergence from it: both q8_0 variants measure a real, bounded difference from f16 on this model.
